typography.usage: Workshop title, activity headings and navigation.
Selective handwritten-style cues, not navigation or long text.

recognitionRules: Use a persistent spine, footer rule and return-to-menu tab.
Pair Avenir instructions with selective Chalkboard annotations.
Use green, cream and gold as the stable frame, with rust for focused cues.
Keep menu bands labeled with activity and planned duration.
Retain evidence IDs when moving from records to proposed tests.

principles: Use short action sentences; follow an invitation with a concrete material, choice or check.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Start with the evidence. Return to the question. Choose a next test together.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid promises that every participant will master the skill.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Try one version, then compare it with the criterion.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use FIELDNOTES WORKSHOP in Avenir with a narrow vertical spine and a small workshop code. No compass or notebook icon.
invariants: Use a persistent spine, footer rule and return-to-menu tab.
Pair Avenir instructions with selective Chalkboard annotations.
Use green, cream and gold as the stable frame, with rust for focused cues.
adaptations: Short workshops can reduce menu items while keeping return navigation.
Print editions replace clickable tabs with page references.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.
